title: NDVI basics — single-band NDVI product (D7 bundle scene: water / vegetation / urban / soil)

assertions.derivation: D7 bundle grid contract: the bundle's deterministic seed-42 scene (bin/sicnu_generate_samples) is 256x256 at 0.001 deg in EPSG:4326; a submission on another grid is not comparable to the known answer. (Calibrated to the shipped scene; the repo copy tracks the D4/D1 fixture.)
NDVI=(N-R)/(N+R) is bounded by [-1,1] for non-negative reflectance (KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX spectral family). Catches display stretches (x100+50) and unit slips.

Measured closed form over the D7 bundle's seed-42 scene (generator reflectance table: water / vegetation / urban / bare soil / forest / shadow with per-band noise): full-scene NDVI mean=0.45742872549, sigma=0.52521106966 with 259 declared-nodata pixels. Mean tolerance 0.01; sigma window [0.50, 0.55] absorbs the generator's fixed noise pattern across compilers. (Calibrated to the shipped scene; the repo copy tracks the D4/D1 fixture.)
The bundle scene declares 259/65536=0.40% invalid pixels; a correct product masks them (observed ratio 0.0040). Ratio 0 = forgot to mask; ratio > 0.05 = masked usable data. Both directions are wrong.

The scene's dominant states (water/urban vs vegetation/forest) put the NDVI histogram in two separated lobes (observed mode centers ~0.08 and ~0.83); bimodality catches stretches that smear the classes.
